quests.name: Weapons of Elunite
quests.summary: <name>, I have crafted these weapons with the elunite you brought to me.  Please, take whichever most suits you.And I must thank you.  Working with elunite is both an honor and a pleasure.

quests.name: Agamand Heirlooms
quests.summary: Bring Coleman Farthing the Agamand Family Axe, the Agamand Family Sword, the Agamand Family Mace and the Agamand Family dagger.

quests.name: Heirloom Weapon
quests.summary: I will keep three of the weapons you returned to me, as mementos of my pain and loss.  But please, <name>, choose your favorite of the heirlooms and keep it for yourself.May it serve you greater than it served its cursed, former owners.

quests.summary: Enter the Rethban Caverns, reach the first fork, and return to Yorus Barleybrew within the time allowed.You must not die and release your spirit.

quests.name: The Shieldsmith
quests.summary: Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.

quests.summary: Bring Furen's Notes to Mathiel.

quests.name: Iron Coral
quests.summary: Bring 20 loads of Searing Coral to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.

quests.name: Brutal Armor
quests.summary: Bring to Thun'grim Firegaze 15 Smoky Iron Ingots, 10 Powdered Azurite, 10 Iron Bars and a Vial of Phlogiston.

quests.name: Brutal Gauntlets
quests.summary: Thank you, <name>.  These gauntlets are my best work.  Take them. In wearing them, you bring honor to me and my ancestors.

quests.name: Brutal Hauberk
quests.summary: I am sure you endured much hardship and shed much blood on my task, <name>.  Here is the product of your toil.May you wear it well, and may you one day return here with stories of its service to you.

quests.name: Brutal Helm
quests.summary: I give this helm to you.Great deeds brought you to me, <name>, and Earthmother willing... even greater deeds lie before you. A quest. Always up to date.

quests.name: Brutal Legguards
quests.summary: Here are your legguards, <name>.  Let me know how they fit or if you need any modifications.  I aim to please!  At least I used to.These days I don't care much for my craft.  But it beats being a mindless minion of the Scourge!I guess.

quests.name: Chimaeric Horn
quests.summary: Bring a Galvanized Horn to Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Dragonmaw Shinbones
quests.summary: Bring 8 Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbones to Velora Nitely in the Undercity.

quests.name: Grimand's Armor
quests.summary: I can barely believe it!  Furen's technique was a success, and this armor should withstand tremendous levels of stress.Here you are, <name>.  And thank you.  I wouldn't have believed Furen's discovery if you hadn't gathered the materials I needed to test it myself.

quests.name: Klockmort's Creation
quests.summary: Here's your armor, <name>.  Furen's process worked brilliantly!  Perfectly!  Marvelously, truly!You could run this armor over with a siege engine and it would spring right back into shape!

quests.name: Mathiel's Armor
quests.summary: I have finished with your piece of armor, and I am quite pleased.  Furen's new techniques meshed perfectly with my own and I am sure this armor will prove to be quite resilient.Thank you, <name>.  And may this serve you well in future battles.

quests.name: Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm

quests.name: Satyr Hooves
quests.summary: Bring 7 Uncloven Satyr Hooves to Ula'elek at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

quests.name: Sunscorched Shells

quests.name: Whirlwind Weapon
quests.summary: I have the whirlwind heart, and am ready to place it within your vessel of choice.Choose your weapon, <name>, and know that its power is the power of Cyclonian.

quests.name: Warrior Kinship
quests.summary: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

quests.name: Just Compensation

quests.name: Lorax's Tale
quests.summary: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

quests.name: More Components of Importance
quests.summary: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

quests.name: The Demon Forge
quests.summary: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

quests.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
quests.summary: You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence.The last step before returning to me is to slay the beast and drive the Heated Ancient Blade into her corpse.Do this and Quel'Serrar will be yours.

quests.name: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
quests.summary: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
